---
title: "Question 3 - Web text extraction and summarisation"
output:
  html_document:
    pandoc_args: ["--resource-path=.:.."]
params:
  rerun: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, comment = "", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

The script fetches one public PyPI page (robots.txt allows it), cleans the text and builds two summaries.
To avoid requesting the page again every time the notebook is knitted, the notebook shows the code and the
saved log of the last run. Knit with `params = list(rerun = TRUE)` to fetch the page again.

```{r code, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("```r\n", paste(readLines("q3_webtext.R"), collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{r run, eval = params$rerun}
source("q3_webtext.R", echo = TRUE, max.deparse.length = Inf)
```
```{r log, eval = !params$rerun}
cat(readLines("outputs/q3_console.txt"), sep = "\n")
```
